versions.content: The AUTOSAR Operating System shall provide a ReleaseSpin- lock function which releases an occupied spinlock. If the spinlock is not occupied an error shall be returned.

Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_80018, SRS_Os_80021 The AUTOSAR Operating System shall provide a ReleaseSpinlock function which releases an occupied spinlock. If the spinlock is not occupied an error shall be re- turned.
